_comment: S8 interest-accrual behavioral fixture. KZ410B reads KZDBALF (avg daily balance + annual rate + period start) and KZCYRF (cycle basis dates), writes KZINTF (truncated-yen accrued interest). GOLDEN uses ACTUAL/365 (D-1403, source-invisible) accruing to the holiday-ROLLED basis date CR-RESOLVED-DT (D-1402, cross-modal→S6). START uses 30/360 accruing to the nominal month-end. The grader recomputes the expected GOLDEN interest from this fixture (resolved date + actual/365), independent of the golden code. C01 is a business-day cycle (nominal==resolved): those accounts isolate the day-count axis. C02 is a HOLIDAY cycle (nominal 0531 rolled back to 0530): those accounts additionally require the rolled basis date. START differs on every account.
